<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def hud_centers():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n'); out={}
    # HUD squares approx cols: pink20-25, red28-31, green34-37, blue40-43 ; center rows58-59
    for name,c0 in [('pink',20),('red',28),('green',34),('blue',40)]:
        out[name]=a[58][c0+1:c0+3]
    return out
def pstate():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation; pt=None;tip=0
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        bb=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bb);r1=max(p[0] for p in bb)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in bb);c1=max(p[1] for p in bb)
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18 and r0<50: pt=(r0,r1)
        if n['color'] in('g','G') and c0>=16 and r0<50: tip=max(tip,c1)
    return pt,tip
print('now', pstate(), hud_centers())
action(['LEFT','LEFT','DOWN','DOWN'])
print('after retract+down', pstate(), hud_centers())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def hud_centers():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n'); out={}
    # HUD squares approx cols: pink20-25, red28-31, green34-37, blue40-43 ; center rows58-59
    for name,c0 in [('pink',20),('red',28),('green',34),('blue',40)]:
        out[name]=a[58][c0+1:c0+3]
    return out
def pstate():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation; pt=None;tip=0
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        bb=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bb);r1=max(p[0] for p in bb)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in bb);c1=max(p[1] for p in bb)
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18 and r0<50: pt=(r0,r1)
        if n['color'] in('g','G') and c0>=16 and r0<50: tip=max(tip,c1)
    return pt,tip
